⚠️ **BEFORE POSTING: READ THIS CAREFULLY** ⚠️

I CANNOT provide legal advice or help with your specific EB-1A case.

## ✅ Appropriate questions:
- Technical issues with the template files
- Typos or formatting errors
- Questions about template structure
- Broken links

## ❌ I WILL CLOSE issues that ask:
- "Do I qualify for EB-1A?"
- "Can you review my petition?"
- "Should I emphasize criterion X or Y?"
- "Is [evidence type] sufficient?"
- Any request for legal advice

**For legal questions, consult a licensed immigration attorney.**
